threads.body: The method now accepts a nullable `value` and returns `null` when `value` is `null`, but the Javadoc still reads like it only returns null on parse failure. Please update the `@param`/`@return` docs to reflect the nullable input behavior (and that `null` input yields `null`).

Consider adding a small regression test that exercises `parsePort(null)` (or a JDBC URL variant that results in a missing/optional port group) to ensure it stays non-throwing and avoids noisy NumberFormatException logging in the future.
